description: set attributes of the plot legend. If a plot name s is not specified, the current view is assumed.

keywords.name: active
keywords.description: Turns the legend on and off (the default is on).

keywords.name: position
keywords.description: Position of the legend if floating, from 0 to 100 (percentage of display size).

keywords.name: size
keywords.description: Size of the legend in percentage of screen width and height.

keywords.name: view-dip
keywords.description: If on, the orientation in the view-info part of the legend is given as dip and dip direction.

keywords.name: copyright
keywords.description: the font used for Itasca's copyright and code restriction information.

keywords.name: heading
keywords.description: the font used to draw the heading.

keywords.name: step
keywords.description: the font used to draw the step number.

keywords.name: time-model
keywords.description: the font used to draw the total time of any active process in the current model.

keywords.name: time-real
keywords.description: the font used to draw the current date and time.

keywords.name: title-customer
keywords.description: the font used to draw the customer title at the bottom of the legend.

keywords.name: view-info
keywords.description: the font used to draw the current camera view information.

examples.description: Dock the legend on the left

notes: The manual's 'text' token is a font block: the live keywords are active, color, family, size and style (no free text argument).
Live, the copyright font block is restricted: only color on 6.00, color and size on 9.8.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on the PFC3D 6.00 and 9.8 GUIs (syntax grade): active, placement, position, size, view-dip and every font block accepted on both GUIs (console builds cannot probe plot commands - they accept any word).
